Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (October 12, 2023) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Ariba Document Number 3943991754 Description: For the non-exclusive supply of all labour, materials, and equipment necessary to perform Auto Body and Collision Damage Repairs for Heavy Duty vehicles and equipment, for the City of Toronto's Fleet Services Division for a period from date of award to April 30, 2024, with the option to renew the contract for additional four (4) separate one (1) year periods.
